description: This file defines an Android activity class 'PictureDetailsActivity' responsible for displaying a detailed view of a photo with animations for entering and exiting the activity. It includes logic for scaling, translating, and colorizing the image, as well as animating the background and description text, primarily used during activity transition effects.

classes.name: PictureDetailsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity displaying a detailed photo view with animated transitions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, retrieves data from intent, and prepares for animation.

methods.name: runEnterAnimation
methods.description: Performs the entrance animation scaling, translating, and colorizing the image, as well as fading background and description.

methods.name: runExitAnimation
methods.description: Performs the reverse animation when exiting, scaling and translating the image back to thumbnail size, fading elements, and restoring saturation.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides back button to run exit animation before finishing the activity.

methods.name: setSaturation
methods.description: Adjusts the saturation level of the image for colorization effect.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Overrides default to suppress transition animations when activity ends.
